evidence_items.explanation: As of mid-2026, humans did about 83% of maintenance on AI-generated files in the repositories studied. This fits the forecast so far but cannot settle a 'long time to come' forecast.

evidence_items.explanation: In early 2026, AI agents often broke working code during long-term maintenance. That is the baseline the forecast starts from, but the same paper reports fast improvement.

unresolved_gaps: The forecast has no deadline. Whether humans are still needed 'for a long time to come' cannot be known on 2026-10-28.
No industry-wide measure exists yet of how much repair of AI-written code is done by humans versus agents.
